title: Alternative(s) to run CUDA on non-Nvidia hardware
summary: This article discusses Spectral Compute's initiative to create CUDA compatibility solutions enabling CUDA code to run on non-Nvidia hardware like AMD and Intel GPUs, challenging Nvidia's dominant position in GPU computing.
problem_solved: Enables developers to run CUDA code on non-Nvidia GPUs without major code rewrites, breaking vendor lock-in.
why_valuable: Promotes healthy competition in GPU hardware market and gives developers freedom to choose hardware without sacrificing their existing CUDA investment.
